documents.rights_basis: The controlling native title/copyright/preface evidence identifies James H. Ryan’s English translation in the 1927 United States Herder printing. Its historical words and mechanical OCR representation are public domain in the United States on the expired publication-term basis. This text contains no later translation or host wrapper.
documents.rights_notice: This identified 1927 English translation and its historical apparatus are public domain in the United States; later translations and host presentation have separate status.
documents.source_note: James H. Ryan English translation, The Encyclicals of Pius XI (Herder,1927), pp.70–98. Fresh mechanical OCR of every page from the identified native facsimile; running headings and folios excluded. Uncorrected OCR spelling, punctuation and printed hard line-end hyphens remain. The historical translator omits the appended prayer to St. Thomas; no complete-act English translation or full word-by-word collation is claimed.
